title: Squirrel Control
summary: Find ten squirrels in Miss Bunny’s increasingly chaotic cottage.
controls: Select visible squirrels; use the optical magnifier for a closer look. The game supplies pause and comfort settings.
limitations: Finding small illustrated characters is a visual task. Progress and preferences stay in this browser.

approval.note: Creator acceptance and public release recorded in the linked release report.

thumbnail.alt: Miss Bunny beside a sofa and squirrels hiding in her cottage.
